subject: MedNexus kickoff: connectivity checklist & backup links
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@mednexus.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-25T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: MedNexus kickoff: connectivity checklist & backup links

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get the kickoff on the calendar. Proposed window: Tue, May 3, 10:00-11:00 PT / 13:00-14:00 ET. Please confirm availability or suggest two alternatives.

To make the session productive, could you:
- Confirm the attendee roster (names + roles) and who will own network/firewall approvals
- Tell us whether you prefer Zoom (recommended), Teams, or an internal VPN connector for recording
- Note any SSO or SAML constraints for shared links

We plan a 60-minute agenda: intros (10), architecture & security Qs (20), implementation timeline & playbook (20), next steps (10). I'll attach a short prework checklist — please circulate to attendees.

Backup plan: primary Zoom link (we'll host) + fallback Jitsi room and PSTN dial-in. If your org restricts external conferencing, let us know and we'll provide a dedicated meeting host in your VPC.

Attachments: mednexus-kickoff-prework.pdf (1 page) — see attached.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions PM | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference

Attachment: mednexus-kickoff-prework.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

Jonas,

Thanks — May 3 works for most of our core team but I need to shift one engineering lead. Can we do May 3, 11:00-12:00 PT / 14:00-15:00 ET instead? If not, May 4 same window should also work.

Attendee roster (confirmed):
- Aisha Khan, Director, Ops (host)
- Miguel Torres, Net/Sec Lead (will arrange firewall exceptions)
- Priya Sharma, Platform Eng (SAML owner)
- Samir Patel, PM (product owner)
- Emily Wong, Customer Success (CS lead)

I've attached our attendee spreadsheet with mobile numbers for PSTN dial-in and timezone offsets.

We prefer Zoom but our security team requires a dial-in PIN for recordings. Who will own recording / storage?

Thanks,
Aisha

--

Hi Aisha — great to meet you over email. May 3 at 11:00 PT works on our side (Jonas confirmed). Well host the Zoom meeting; Laura will be the primary host and Jonas will be co-host. Dev will run the preflight test.

Proposed meeting artefacts we will share:
- Kickoff agenda (attached as kickoff-agenda-v1.md)
- Implementation owner grid (short table we will paste into the invite)
- Shared Slack channel invite (post-kickoff)

Meeting links (primary + fallback):
- Primary: Zoom — https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode will be in calendar invite)
- Fallback: Jitsi room — https://meet.jit.si/mednexus-kickoff
- PSTN dial-in: +1 646 555 0100; PIN 4321 (will rotate per security request)

Recording policy: we can record and deliver the meeting to MedNexus S3 bucket if you provide an upload endpoint or a secure SFTP host. Alternatives: we can provide raw MP4 to a Redwood tenant (if allowed) and you can ship to your secure storage. Please confirm which you prefer; we'll honor your compliance needs.

Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10)
2) Network & SSO checklist walkthrough (15)
3) Deployment topology & staging plan (20)
4) Implementation timeline & milestones (10)
5) Action items & next steps (5)

I'll push a calendar invite after we lock the time.

Best,
Laura

--
